english.title: Sex offenders register - fail to notify the non occurrence of a proposed event - SOA 2003
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a relevant offender within the terms of section 80 of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 and having previously given notification as required by section 84(1) of that Act in relation to a change in the particulars provided, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CHANGE..), failed without reasonable excuse to give notification of the fact that the event did not occur as required by section 84(4)(b) of that Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section91(1)(a) and (2) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
